Debt Crisis Grips Romania’s Industrial Intermediate Prod Sector, Forcing Factory Shutdowns and Job Cuts

BUCHAREST, June 12 – Romania’s Industrial Intermediate Prod industry is facing a mounting debt crisis, with several key manufacturers halting production and thousands of jobs at risk as credit conditions tighten and payments on existing loans become unmanageable.

The crisis began to unfold last week after lenders sharply curtailed credit lines to the sector, citing rising default risks and deteriorating financial metrics. At least four major firms, including the Cluj-based SinterTech and Bucharest’s ProCore Materials, have temporarily closed production sites, leaving over 1,800 workers on unpaid leave or reduced hours, according to the National Association of Intermediate Producers (NAIP).

“Factories are running out of working capital and can no longer cover payroll or operational expenses,” said Adrian Radu, NAIP president. “We urgently need a coordinated response to prevent mass layoffs and irreversible damage to our production base.”

Sector analysts estimate that outstanding debts across the industry now total more than 1.2 billion lei ($260 million), up 40% from the start of the year. Many companies, especially small and mid-sized firms, are reportedly struggling to refinance short-term obligations as interest rates climb and access to new credit dries up.

“There is a real risk of cascading insolvencies if the current freeze persists,” warned Simona Drăghici, an analyst at Central Europe Industrial Watch. “The financial health of the sector has deteriorated rapidly, and without intervention, we could see permanent closures.”

Workers at affected sites described growing uncertainty about their future. “We were told to stay home until further notice,” said Ionut Preda, a technician at the now-idle SinterTech plant. “People are worried about how long this will last, and if our jobs will come back.”

The crisis remains ongoing, with industry leaders calling for urgent talks with policymakers and creditors.
